title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook + quality gating metrics integration
author: Priya Patel
description: This PR adds a per-prompt regression CI hook to the eval-harness that runs targeted evaluations for changed prompt sets and publishes per-prompt metrics to the CI metrics pipeline. Motivation: reduce silent quality regressions by surfacing per-prompt degradations in CI and enabling automatic quality gating. Changes include a reusable per-prompt hook runner, integration with the existing metrics exporter, configurable thresholds for quality gates, and a small set of canonical prompt-set tests to exercise the hook in CI. Checklist: [x] add per-prompt hook runner, [x] integrate with metrics exporter, [x] add unit + integration tests, [x] add docs and example config, [x] update CI yaml to wire the hook, [x] add release notes. Related: ENG-3245, ENG-3399. See inline notes for design decisions and rollout plan.

release_notes: Adds per-prompt regression CI hook that runs eval-harness against changed prompt-sets and publishes per-prompt metrics to CI metrics pipeline. Includes configurable quality gates to fail CI when per-prompt quality drops below thresholds. Defaults are conservative; teams can opt-in via config. Backward compatible. See eval-harness/ci/hooks/README.md for usage.
notes: Rollout plan: default hook is disabled for monorepo until we enable per-team opt-in. Initial rollout gated to small set of prompt-owners to calibrate thresholds over 2 weeks. Observability: dashboards added to CI metrics namespace for per-prompt accuracy and drift alerts.
test_plan: Unit tests added for threshold logic. Integration test exercises a small prompt-set in CI. Manual local run documented in README. CI pipeline ensures metrics ingestion smoke test passes before merging.
